description: Find products with the highest agent readiness scores — products that are easiest for AI agents to integrate with. Sorted by compositeScore desc; supports skip/limit pagination. All readiness scores are 0-100, higher better. Calibration: <30 = not agent-ready (default minimumScore filter), 30-49 = early/limited, 50-69 = decent, 70-89 = strong, 90+ = exceptional. Ranking basis: compositeScore desc. Tier is NOT a tiebreaker here — buyer intent is technical fit, not paid placement. Every result carries { position (1-based, within the returned page), rank (0..1; 1.0 = top of this page) } so callers can merge results across tools consistently. Response: { products: [{ position, rank, slug, name, tagline, websiteUrl, tier (free|verified|featured), unverified (true when no approved vendor claim), verifiedAt (ISO; nullable), agentReadiness: { compositeScore, apiScore, protocolScore, sdkScore, integrationScore, dxScore } (each 0-100), mcp?: { hasMcpSupport, totalToolCount, serverCount } }] }.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Caps at 50.

minimumScore.description: Minimum composite agent readiness score (0-100). Higher = more agent-ready. 0 returns everything; 50 is a usable threshold.

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination). Default 0.

name: products.find_agent_ready
